$comment: FICTIONAL demo input (T-29). Marcia, 58, Jamaican Patois/English. Needs native-speaker check of the Patois wording.
mainConcern: Mi knee dem a hurt mi bad fi bout two month now, especially di right one. Mi cyaan walk up di stairs dem good again.

timing.note: It worse inna di morning when mi first get up

changes: When rain a come it hurt more. If mi siddung long, it stiff up. Mi try walk likkle every day.
medicines: Mi tek paracetamol sometime, two tablet. Mi use di cream weh di pharmacy gi mi.
worries: Mi fraid seh dem a go tell mi fi stop work. Mi nuh always understand when di doctor talk fast.
